title: Real-time server push trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for realtime-server-push trace events.

transport.description: Technical code for the transport this run uses; null on the comparison event.

app.description: The client this channel belongs to, as the example named it.

now.description: The current tick. Time is discrete so a run is fully deterministic.

online.description: Whether the browser can currently reach the server at all.

duplex.description: Technical code for which side may send; the visualizer localizes it.

interval.description: Short polling only: ticks between two requests.

hold.description: Long polling only: ticks the server may park a request before answering empty.

connection.description: What, if anything, is currently held open between the two sides.

open.description: True when the server could write to the client right now.

kind.description: Technical code for what is open: nothing, a parked request, an SSE stream, a WebSocket.

openedAt.description: Long polling: the tick the parked request was opened at; null when nothing is parked.

lastEventId.description: The id of the last event the client saw — what SSE resends as Last-Event-ID.

sharedBus.description: Whether instances publish events to a shared bus so any of them can reach a connection.

instances.description: How many server instances are running behind the load balancer.

queue.description: News that exists on the server and has not reached the browser yet.

id.description: Event id, as SSE would send it.

label.description: What happened, in the example's own words.

waited.description: Ticks it has been waiting so far.

delivered.description: News that reached the screen, with the delay it took.

timeline.description: One cell per elapsed tick, so the cost of a transport is visible at a glance.

serverEvent.description: Something happened on the server in this tick.

request.description: The client started an HTTP request in this tick.

empty.description: A request came back with nothing.

delivery.description: Something reached the browser in this tick.

held.description: A connection or parked request was open during this tick.

stats.description: Running totals for the whole run — the bill for this transport.

requests.description: HTTP requests the client started, handshakes included.

empty.description: Requests that came back with no news.

frames.description: Messages written into an already-open connection.

lost.description: Events that never reached it and never will.

avgLatency.description: Average ticks between an event and its delivery.

comparison.description: Only on TRANSPORT_COMPARED: the same timeline priced by each transport.

held.description: Whether this transport keeps something open per client.
